# Rōmy

> Rōmy helps small nonprofits find new major donors at a fraction of the cost of existing solutions.

Rōmy is a donor intelligence platform built for small nonprofit teams. It uses AI-powered prospect research to surface wealth indicators, giving histories, and affinity signals — then distills them into actionable donor profiles. It is built as a purpose-built, lower-cost alternative to enterprise wealth-screening platforms such as DonorSearch, iWave, and WealthEngine, which typically cost $15,000-$50,000 per year.

## Features

- Donor Discovery: AI-powered prospect research with wealth indicators, giving history, and affinity signals
- Fraction of the Cost: No enterprise contracts or per-seat licensing — donor intelligence at a price built for small nonprofits
- Ready to Act On: Every prospect comes with connection points, giving capacity, and outreach angles
- RōmyScore: a normalized 0-100 donor capacity/affinity score with a category breakdown
- Sourced research: every claim in a Rōmy report links to its source

## Benchmarks

Rōmy publishes PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark), an open comparison of AI systems on donor prospect research accuracy, hallucination rate, and report completeness. Results and methodology: https://getromy.app/labs
